notes: Range 9000-16999. Left English on purpose: ~150 battle floatTexts callouts (STUN, SILENCED, FEAR!, WAX, OVERDUE x3, spell names...) - ftIsStatus (base 6793) and FT_DEBUFF_RE (base 6799) classify a float by its English text (all-caps = status column, debuff words = under the feet), so translating them changes the layout; they need a status/debuff flag on the float first (another range). Also left: music track titles + Pixabay credits (11091-11133), role/damageProfile compares (Tank/Mage/Magic...), summon keys, console/Error text (window evidence rejected, FX MISS), item names Superior XP Potion / Hero XP Potion (15850, 15928), PROV_META names, RESULT_LOST_MSG + resultNotCountedText (base 24197/24221, outside range), the God Mode ' (DEV)' tag (15299, dev only).

Road names in Gauntlet banners use new keys gauntlet.road_top/mid/bottom (indexed by lane .i) with GSPLIT_ROAD_NAME (base 7300, outside this range) as the fallback - whoever converts 7300/8439-8441 can reuse those keys.

Boss cues: CHAPTER_BOSS_CUE / BOSS_CUES arrays are kept as the English fallback; bossCueFor translates at the display site with bosscue.ch1..ch16 (boss name passed as {boss}) and bosscue.<monster key>.
Server error text on result screens (d.error / r.error) now goes through langMsg() at the display site only.
tests/test_shop_sweep_1097.js line 63 asserts /CLAIM HOURLY FRAGMENTS/ in the page html - still true only because the build writes the English into the inline EW_LANG_EN.

tests/test_results_retry_1151.js lines 101-203 (puppeteer) assert English result titles DUNGEON CLEARED / ELITE CLEARED / NOT COUNTED / THE VAULT HOLDS / DEFEAT and Gauntlet banners /BONUS 1-3 CLEARED/, /RUN LOST/, /RETRY RESULT/, /not confirmed/i and reward text /Victory saved/ - they pass in English (t() falls back to English); would fail if the test browser's language were not English.
tests/test_won_never_defeat_1145.js lines 20-33 (puppeteer) assert the campaign result title NOT COUNTED / VICTORY / DEFEAT - same: English-only runtime check.
